description:
Currently a turn is scattered across multiple Transcript entries: AssistantHeader (key turn-N:header), N block entries (key turn-N:block-K), AssistantStatus (key turn-N:status). weld_assistant_turns exists only because no single entry owns the turn.

Replace with a single AssistantMessage Transcript entry per turn (key turn-N). Its render/2 returns %VZone{type: :output} wrapping all content for text turns, or the content VFlow directly for tool-use turns.

File: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message.ex

Struct:
  defstruct blocks: [],          # [{id, :text|:thinking, snapshot, finalized?}]
            has_tool_calls?: false,
            stop_reason: nil,
            error_message: nil

Streaming protocol:
  def update(%__MODULE__{} = self, {:upsert_block, id, kind, snapshot}), do: ...
  def update(%__MODULE__{} = self, {:finalize_block, id}),               do: ...
  def update(%__MODULE__{} = self, {:set_tool_calls, bool}),             do: ...
  def finalize(%__MODULE__{} = self, {reason, error_msg}),               do: ...

Render:
  def render(%__MODULE__{blocks: []} = self, _ctx),
    do: {self, %VDOM.VFlow{children: []}, nil}

  def render(%__MODULE__{has_tool_calls?: true} = self, ctx),
    do: {self, content_vflow(self, ctx), nil}   # no zone for tool-use turns

  def render(%__MODULE__{} = self, ctx) do
    vnode = %VDOM.VZone{type: :output, id: "assistant",
                        children: content_vflow(self, ctx)}
    {self, vnode, nil}
  end

  defp content_vflow/2 renders each block via its component (TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, etc.), appends status line if stop_reason warrants it (mirrors AssistantStatus logic)

Event handler changes in interactive.ex:
- MessageStart (line 1244): append %AssistantMessage{} with key "turn-N" instead of %AssistantHeader{}
- MessageBlockStart/Delta/End (lines 1264–1284): Transcript.update(t, "turn-N", {:upsert_block, ...}) and {:finalize_block, ...} instead of appending/upserting separate block entries
- MessageEnd (line 1286): Transcript.update then Transcript.finalize({stop_reason, error_msg}) instead of appending %AssistantStatus{}
- maybe_update_header_tool_flag/3 (line 1298): logic moves into :set_tool_calls update message — delete the helper

⚠ Read Transcript.update/3 protocol at transcript.ex:77 before implementing — entry.__struct__.update(entry, snapshot) call must match update/2 clauses above.
⚠ render/2 must be safe to call mid-stream (partial blocks, no stop_reason). Empty blocks → empty VFlow. In-flight blocks render current snapshot.
⚠ Read append_block/3, upsert_block/3, finalize_block/2 in interactive.ex before cutting — full logic must transfer into update message handlers.

Tests: Complete text turn → VZone with content. Tool-use turn → VFlow, no zone. Partial stream (no status) → content VFlow, no zone. Error stop → error line in content. Empty → empty VFlow.
title: AssistantMessage composite component
